environment.description: FastAPI service on ECS Fargate behind ALB with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (3) a custom regex pattern rule on the request body matching field 'output_format' against pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10}$ with BLOCK action and field match scope on FORM_DATA with transformation URL_DECODE applied. Container runs with read-only root filesystem and tmpfs mount at /tmp with noexec,nosuid,size=64m flags. Task role has no EFS access; /tmp is container-local ephemeral storage.

waf_rules: Custom regex rule: output_format field must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10}$ after URL_DECODE, BLOCK action
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
